newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends higher in light technical trade.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends higher in light technical trade.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures retraced earlier losses and closed slightly higher in dull, technically-driven buying, market sources said.
Buy stops were triggered once the market climbed towards unchanged, and a lack of selling allowed prices to rise to the day's highs.
Producer selling is expected to cap the March contract around resistance at 75.50, where bigger buy stops are resting, Sharon Johnson, an analyst with Frank Schneider and Co Inc, said.
Support remained at 73.00 cents in March.
The March contract ended up 0.24 at 75.35, traded 75.40 to 74.70. The back months settled 0.05 lower to 0.27 higher.
Johnson said some players probably covered short positions ahead of Thursday's export and sales report.
Expectations for rubust sales persist, since prices fell in the last two weeks that the new sales data were strong, she said.
